From Wiktionary, the free dictionary See also: Appendix:Variations of "ja" Translingual[edit] Symbol[edit] JA (international standards) Indeterminately reserved ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for Jamaica. synonym ▲Synonym: JM (for general use) Usage notes[edit] This is an indeterminately reserved code, included as part of ISO 3166-1 on the request of the Secretary-General of the United Nations due to its use in designating road vehicles under the 1949 Geneva Convention on Road Traffic, and is not endorsed for general use by the ISO. The general-purpose code for Jamaica is JM. English[edit] Etymology 1[edit] Proper noun[edit] JA Abbreviation of Japan: a country in East Asia (NATO country code). Abbreviation of Jamaica: a country in the Caribbean. Abbreviation of Jalisco: a state of Mexico. Abbreviation of Jambi: a province of Indonesia. Abbreviation of Jammu and Kashmir: a union territory of India. (law, postnominal) Abbreviation of judge or justice of a court of appeal. Etymology 2[edit] Borrowed from German JA (“Junge Alternative für Deutschland”). Proper noun[edit] JA (German politics) Young Alternative for Germany. quotations ▼ Anagrams[edit] AJ German[edit] Proper noun[edit] JA f (proper noun, genitive JA) (German politics) initialism of Junge Alternative für Deutschland.
